findings.text: follow-on: the inline step-halving loop added to _adaptive (nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:559-584) re-implements the backtracking line search the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:1147 (_select_backtracking_candidate, with _backtracking_scores and _SUFFICIENT_DECREASE_SLOPE) and, inside this chain, at scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py:655-672; it extends neither owner, so a step-size policy now lives in three places that can drift.

follow-on: the take expression accepts a candidate whenever missing_rows is true, i.e. with no test that the candidate merit decreased, so the guard can commit the class of step it exists to refuse; the non-finite or out-of-domain candidate is taken on no evidence because candidate_merit fails the isfinite test on exactly those rows.

follow-on: test_adjacent_saddle_booking_keeps_one_representation asserts only that cell 266 stays booked and that the accepted current varies by less than 1e-8 across two adjacent offsets; the brief's clause (1) asks the ordinary and saddle-fragment booking of one cell to agree within the booking's own quadrature error, which this test never measures, and the run's own evidence records that cross-path gap as 0.960895625 A delegated to the following cut-geometry node.

follow-on: the after_suite record names revision 8993e1a5d67e34d21bd935edc5e6a0b7df68d407 while the reviewed head is e9444fd44c35688678eea60b3cc0873125927ab3; the three commits between them touch only docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/read-correction-path.html and docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/read-correction-path/terminal-forward-states.svg, so the suite result does describe the reviewed code, but the receipt does not name the revision a reader is comparing.
